BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain gripper-strips)
(:requirements :strips)
(:types robot gripper room object)
(:predicates
(at-robby ?r - robot ?x - room)
(free ?r - robot ?g - gripper)
(at ?o - object ?x - room)
(carry ?r - robot ?g - gripper ?o - object)
)

(:action move
:parameters (?r - robot ?from - room ?to - room)
:precondition (at-robby ?r ?from)
:effect (and (at-robby ?r ?to)
(not (at-robby ?r ?from))))

(:action pick
:parameters (?r - robot ?g - gripper ?o - object ?x - room)
:precondition (and (at ?o ?x) (at-robby ?r ?x) (free ?r ?g))
:effect (and (carry ?r ?g ?o)
(not (at ?o ?x))
(not (free ?r ?g))))

(:action drop
:parameters (?r - robot ?g - gripper ?o - object ?x - room)
:precondition (and (carry ?r ?g ?o) (at-robby ?r ?x))
:effect (and (not (carry ?r ?g ?o))
(at ?o ?x)
(free ?r ?g)))
)
END DOMAIN
